notes: MPFB2 works headless on Blender 4.0.2 with 3 local install patches (see below); NO asset-pack download needed (basemesh+default rig ship in repo, 73MB). A=male/red, B=female/blue (note: gender 0.0=female, 1.0=male). Flat Principled tints, no skins/clothes (asset pack skipped). Jaw verified numerically (rot -X opens chin). Render 11.5s vs trackC 607s (flat mats, no SSS). Patches to installed copy ~/.config/blender/4.0/scripts/addons/mpfb only: (1) bl_info=fake_bl_info alias for pre-4.2 addon API; (2) bpy.utils.extension_path_user shim in runner scripts; (3) export LOWEST_FUNCTIONAL_BLENDER_VERSION from services/__init__.py (upstream import bug). Non-fatal 'malformed node' ValueError logged during add_builtin_rig (upstream, result fine). Bald, nude-but-flat-shaded mannequins.
